slug: 2024-07-25 Africa Data Centres adding 6MW capacity in Cape Town

facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports Africa Data Centres claims its Cape Town CPT1 facility has a water usage effectiveness rating of zero; the date is the article's publication date, as it gives none for the claim.
The article says CPT1 uses wheeled solar power under a 20-year power purchase agreement signed in March 2023 with Distributed Power Africa, a Cassava Technologies company.

note: No PUE figure is given, only a 'strong' rating, so no pue fact.
